name: Rajasthan Family Income Certificate
prerequisites: Jan Aadhaar family record must be available
All earning family members must have income proof

required_documents.description: Aadhaar or equivalent identity proof for each family member
Address proof (utility bill, rent agreement, or address on Aadhaar)
Salary slip, Form 16, or employer letter for salaried earning members
ITR, bank statement, or self-declaration for non-salaried earning members
Passport-size photo of the primary applicant

cross_checks.description: Name on identity proof must match name on income proof and application
Address on identity proof should match address proof
Every earning family member must have at least one income proof document
Intended use deadline must fall within 12 months from today
Document OCR confidence should be above 0.75 for reliable extraction
